def auto_stamp(g):
 from collections import Counter
 flat=[v for row in g for v in row]
 ctr=Counter(flat)

 color=min((v for v in ctr if v not in (0,bg)),key=lambda v:ctr[v])
 return stamp(g,color,0)[0]

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    nonzero = [value for value in counts if value != 0]
    background = max(nonzero, key=counts.get)
    marker = min((value for value in nonzero if value != background), key=counts.get)

    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in cells]
    height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
